adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent, the new fallback logic is `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (undefined/null), the `find` compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `=== undefined/null`), which will not match normal string `externalId`s, yielding `undefined`. The previous code correctly fell back to `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`; the new code does not provide an equivalent fallback (e.g., first destination calendar or primary), so it can pass an undefined calendarId to `calendar.events.update`.
